capability: Every fix ships with a check that fails on the old copy
title: The old bug meets a door.

hook.picture: Close on the whale patching a kink in the line with care; the line runs smooth.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We fixed that last month. Why is it back?
problem_in_viewer_words.who: support lead reading a repeat bug report

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: each fix is made by hand and nothing remembers it; an old copy of the line slides back in, kink and all. Three-times device: the old copy slides back three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, the kink returning each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nothing stops the old version coming back.

stakes.body: Every repeat costs the fix twice and tells users the team is not listening.

solution_hint: Ship each fix with its own check.

metaphor.body: Every patch leaves a small door right behind it, cut to the shape of the old kink, so the old copy can never slip back through.

steps.picture: The whale patches the kink, then plants a small gate right behind the patch.
steps.words: Ship each fix with its own check.
steps.sound: Patch stitch, then a small latch

steps.picture: A ghost of the old kinked line slides in, hits the new gate and bounces off; a flag marks it.
steps.sound: Bounce thud, then a clean bell

steps.picture: The fixed line passes the same gate cleanly; the gate glows.
steps.words: Old copy fails. New copy passes.

steps.picture: The gate gets its name on its post.
steps.words: The old bug's own check: a gate.

real_case.claim: The loop-engineering repo could not be read (UNGROUNDED). The jury doctrine "Every fix ships with a check that fails on the old copy"; in the jury run, fixers on disjoint files went 0/22 → 22/22, 0/15 → 15/15 and 0/16 → 16/16.

honest_limit.picture: A brand-new kink of a different shape slides through the gate untouched; a flag rises far downstream.
honest_limit.words: A new bug walks right past.

not_this.body: A check stops repeats, not new bugs.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns. The whale patches the kink; on the same beat as bar 2 the old kink tries to return and bounces off the gate; the line stays smooth; the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The kink that came back in bar 2 tries again in the same framing and is stopped.

end_belief.body: Every fix leaves a check behind.
